inference.observedPrecedence: For the tested ESXi build and Root Port path, disableACSCheck=TRUE bypasses ACS admission even when enableACSCheckForRP=TRUE
inference.baselineScope: With no explicit ACS boot option, this ESXi 8.0.3 build logged disableACSCheck=FALSE and enableACSCheckForRP=FALSE; this is a build-and-path observation, not a cross-version default guarantee
inference.notProved: The option does not synthesize hardware ACS, create a physical isolation boundary, or make peer DMA traverse the IOMMU
inference.qemuPolicy: Treat an ESXi ACS-check bypass and a Linux ACS-override-dependent split as degraded isolation provenance; compute and lease the physical isolation domain independently
